messages.text: ERCOT deployed Non-Spin at 100% of awards from 17:43 to 22:05.

messages.content: I’ll commit a day-ahead book that pairs low-price solar charging with evening discharge and reserve awards, then reassess energy dispatch at each live watch. The ancillary-service awards will be fixed after this watch.

Midday RT prices have turned negative. Regulation down has charged the battery faster than forecast, and the controller has used some discharge allowance to preserve reserve headroom. I’m reducing the remaining charging and evening discharge to account for that.

ERCOT has deployed Non-Spin through 22:05. We have no Non-Spin awards, so there is no direct deployment obligation. I’m keeping the remaining evening discharge and increasing the 23:00 recharge, since regulation down may deliver less energy during the shortage.
